risks: Valuation disconnect: 90x TTM EPS, 5.9x book against FY26 ROE 5.4% — engine FV Rs 176 vs price Rs 1,983 (11.2x); even the ACC trigger (Rs 168) is 92% below the price
Capacity payback unproven: reactor capacity nearly tripled since FY22 but revenue per KL fell from ~Rs 1.47cr to ~Rs 0.64cr (tradebrains) — the Dahej/Jolva capex must convert to volumes at margin
Cash machine not yet: FCF negative 5/5 years (FY26 -Rs 82cr); Jolva needs ~Rs 200cr; borrowing limit raised to Rs 1,000cr — leverage creep is the funding path if accruals lag
Campaign lumpiness: SDA (34% of Q1 sales) is campaign-based and ESS is volatile — quarterly prints will swing even if the annual story holds
Working capital drag: CCC 185 days, debtor days 86, inventory days 141; FY26 CFO/OP only 42% — growth consumes cash before it returns it
Promoter 72.02% concentration with thin institutional float (FII 3.93%, DII 3.11%) — sharp moves on news flow
thesis: A real specialty-chemicals franchise mid-turnaround — FY26 revenue +32% to Rs 506cr, EBITDA margin back to 18.4%, Q1 FY27 +43% with CRISIL upgrading the bank facilities to A-/Stable. But it is priced for a transformation the numbers have not delivered: 90x earnings and 5.9x book against 5.4% ROE, FCF negative five years running, and asset productivity (revenue/KL) down 57% since FY22. The engine values the equity at Rs 176 (0.53x book) on 3.4% sustainable growth; the market at Rs 1,983 is paying for a permanent return to 20%+ ROE. Quality of the recovery is not in doubt — the price is. This becomes interesting only on a deep derating toward the Rs 157-168 trigger zone.
